bondPriority.description: Increases All-Skill Mastery by 7% and Ailment Mastery by 7% during battle. When equipped by a Full Assault character, increases Strike Mastery by an extra 15%.
bondPriority.name: Grimmjow Bond

bondPriority.description: During battle, DMG dealt increases by 8%. This increases to 12% / 16% / 20%, if Crit Rate reaches 20% / 40% / 60%.
bondPriority.name: Toshiro Bond

boundaries.description: The passive, Bare Killing Intent, increases the maximum stack of Killing Intent to 10. Each stack also increases the damage of the next Special Attack, Pounce, by 5%.
boundaries.name: Evolutionary Path

boundaries.description: When Pounce hits an enemy, it immediately deals Lacerate DMG. The Prey Mark applied to the enemy also reduces their Strike Resistance by 10%.
boundaries.name: Spare No One

boundaries.description: When Prey Mark applied by Pounce ends, it deals an additional round of damage to the enemy equal to 15% of the total Strike DMG the target took during Prey Mark, up to a maximum of 3000× Grimmjow's current ATK.
boundaries.name: Worth the Hunt

boundaries.description: Grimmjow enters Destructive Urge immediately after battle starts. Lacerate Points accumulation rate increased by 40%. Each Lacerate trigger grants 8% All-Skill Mastery and 20% Crit DMG for 15 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
boundaries.name: I Will Be King

builds.subStatPriority: Crit Rate (50%) > ATK% > Crit DMG > Flat ATK > Ailment%

corePassives.description:
When Grimmjow's Spiritual Pressure is equal to or above 50, tap and hold Basic Attack to enter Rush. 
 Release the Basic Attack button during Rush to make Grimmjow release Pounce on the target and apply Prey Mark. When Grimmjow attacks a target affected by Prey Mark, he applies Lacerate Points. Triggers Lacerate once for every 100 Lacerate Points accumulated, dealing Ailment DMG equal to 200% of ATK to the target.
corePassives.name: Royal Hunt

corePassives.description: After Grimmjow actively crashes into an enemy using Sonido or his technique, Razor Kick, Perfect Dodge is triggered. Each time Perfect Dodge is triggered, Grimmjow gains 20% ATK for 25 seconds. Unstackable.
corePassives.name: Panther Speed

corePassives.description:
After Grimmjow enters Rush, he gains 1 stack of Killing Intent every 0.1 second, up to 5 stacks. 
 When releasing Special Attack, Pounce, all Killing Intent stacks are consumed to increase Grimmjow's Crit DMG by 15% per stack for 10 seconds.
corePassives.name: Bare Killing Intent

skills.description:
Grimmjow strikes the enemy 6 times with his claws, dealing damage equal to 850% of ATK and gaining Spiritual Pressure. ~~Pounce~~ Release Basic Attack While Under Rush 
 After Rush, Grimmjow pounces at the target, dealing damage equal to 270% of ATK. ~~Pounce Pursuit~~ Automatically released after using Pounce 
 After pouncing at the target, Grimmjow immediately pursues them, dealing damage equal to 275% of ATK and gaining 1 Hunting Point.
skills.name: Grind, Pantera!

skills.description:
Grimmjow sweeps enemies with the blades on his legs, dealing damage equal to 600% of ATK. ~~Violent Clutch~~ Tap Technique again after releasing Razor Kick 
 Grimmjow tightly grabs the target, then follows up with a powerful kick, dealing damage equal to 660% of ATK and obtaining 1 Hunting Point. ~~Ferocious Combo~~ Consuming Hunting Points After Releasing Pounce Pursuit 
 Grimmjow leaps above the target, then darts rapidly across the battlefield while slashing them, dealing damage equal to 700% of ATK. 
 After releasing this technique, he can consume 2 more Hunting Points to continue pursuing the enemy. ~~Death Grip~~ Consuming Hunting Points After Releasing Ferocious Combo 
 Grimmjow leaps high into the air again, then crashes down onto the target with a heavy impact, dealing damage equal to 1800% of ATK.
skills.name: Razor Kick

skills.description: Grimmjow releases his strongest move, dealing damage equal to 6600% of ATK to enemies with a devastating strike.
skills.name: Desgarron

skills.description: After countering an enemy attack, Grimmjow fires several Panther Hooks from his elbows. They explode on hit, dealing damage equal to 1950% of ATK and granting him 1 Hunting Point.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
Use Sonido to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Grimmjow gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds. 
 Triggering Perfect Dodge grants Grimmjow 1 Hunting Point.
skills.name: Sonido
